title: Dieneces
summary: Raleigh names Dieneces in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Dieneces the Spartan, who answered that if the Persian arrowes hid the Sunne, then they should fight in the coole shade. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter VI, §. III, sig. 412b
